releaseNotes:
• Multi-item carousels: Fixed 6-item truncation; full 10-15+ items extract immediately via direct Vue state inspection
• Lightning-fast History & Archive: Instant <50ms load with asynchronous MediaStore reconciliation
• Universal cover thumbnails: All posts & deleted archives show fast, lightweight preview thumbnails via zero-auth CDN
• Modern In-App OTA Update: Sleek native update dialog with progress bar and one-tap install
• Clean Settings: Removed wireless ADB and diagnostic clutter; dynamically bound true version (v1.1.1)
